sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF FL
sections.text: ...CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS ENEWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY... COMPLEX FORECAST THROUGH TONIGHT ACROSS THIS REGION WITH VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND ABUNDANT LOW LEVEL THETA-E ALREADY IN PLACE...ALTHOUGH MAJORITY OF FLOW ALOFT WILL REMAIN ATOP COOL-SIDE OF SURFACE COLD FRONT. SEVERAL STRONG/SEVERE COMPLEXES ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE...WITH ONGOING SYSTEM ALONG AREA OF ENHANCED ASCENT OVERSPREADING NWRN MN THROUGH THE AFTERNOON /REFERENCE WW 497 AND ATTENDANT DISCUSSIONS TODAY/. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR WITH SYSTEM NEARER WARM FRONT OVER SRN MN/NRN IA GIVEN EXTREME INSTABILITY IN PLACE AHEAD OF IT...WITH SUBSEQUENT SEVERE THREAT POSSIBLY OVERSPREADING THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY INTO THE EVENING. SEVERAL SUBTLE IMPULSES LIFTING NNEWD ACROSS CENTRAL ROCKIES SHOULD SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS WITH POSSIBLE EVOLUTION INTO ADDITIONAL MCSS OVERNIGHT ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF THE OUTLOOK. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS...WITH POTENTIAL FOR MORE WIDESPREAD RISK WITH SEVERE MCS DEVELOPMENT WITH ANY OF THESE COMPLEXES.

sections.title: CENTRAL/NERN GULF COAST INTO FL
sections.text: PRIMARY MCS HAS EXITED SOUTH FL AS OF 16Z...ALTHOUGH TRAILING OUTFLOW/WEST COAST SEA BREEZE SHOULD CONTINUE FOCUSING DEVELOPMENT SWD THROUGH THE DAY ACROSS WRN/CENTRAL PORTIONS OF S FL THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. ASCENT/MID LEVEL MOISTENING EVIDENT ON WV IMAGERY SPREADING TOWARDS THE CENTRAL/NERN GULF COAST EARLY THIS AFTERNOON SHOULD ALLOW SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE DAY WITH STRONG HEATING. ISOLATED WIND/HAIL NEAR OR JUST EXCEEDING SEVERE LIMITS WILL LIKELY ACCOMPANY STRONGER CORES.

sections.title: SRN ROCKIES
sections.text: PLUME OF GREATER PW/S WILL PERSIST ALONG EDGE OF LARGE SCALE RIDGE WITHIN SLY FLOW OVER THE SRN ROCKIES. MOIST CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BECOME WIDESPREAD ACROSS THIS REGION WITH AFTERNOON HEATING...AND AN ISOLATED STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE GUST MAY ACCOMPANY MORE ROBUST CORES INTO THE EVENING. ..EVANS/JEWELL.. 06/23/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS SOUTH FL
sections.text: ...UPPER MS VALLEY... SQUALL LINE CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE ALONG A LINE FROM MKT...IN SRN MN...SWD TO SW OF FOD IN CNTRL IA. THIS ACTIVITY HAS RE-INTENSIFIED ALONG LEADING EDGE OF OLD MCS THAT MIGRATED ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS OVERNIGHT. CURRENT MOVEMENT IS ROUGHLY 30-35KT WHICH SUGGESTS CONVECTION SHOULD EASILY SPREAD INTO SWRN WI/NWRN IL BY EARLY EVENING. LAPSE RATES ARE STEEPENING SIGNIFICANTLY DOWNSTREAM ACROSS NRN IL/SRN WI...ALONG WITH INCREASING INSTABILITY. THOUGH SHEAR IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...IT APPEARS SQUALL LINE WILL CONTINUE MOVING EAST BEFORE TURNING SE AT ROUGHLY 30KT. THREAT FOR STRONG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WITH THIS ACTIVITY NECESSITATE AN EWD EXTENSION OF THE SLIGHT RISK DOWNSTREAM.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: SATELLITE/RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST A WEAK IMPULSE IS LIFTING NWD ACROSS NM WITHIN DEEPER MOISTURE PLUME THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS NWD INTO CNTRL CO. CONVECTION IS INCREASING MARKEDLY ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF CO AND THIS TREND SHOULD CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS WITH DEEP CONVECTION EXPECTED TO SPREAD/DEVELOP NEWD ALONG/NORTH OF WEAK WIND SHIFT WITHIN UPSLOPE FLOW TOWARD THE NEB PANHANDLE. 18Z SOUNDING FROM LBF IS CURRENTLY CAPPED...BUT CONTINUED HEATING AND LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE STRONGLY FAVOR ROBUST DEEP CONVECTION ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS. SHEAR PROFILES ALSO SUGGEST A FEW SUPERCELLS MAY BE EMBEDDED WITHIN THIS ACTIVITY.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS...A FEW SEVERE...WILL PERSIST ALONG LOW LEVEL CONFLUENCE ZONE THAT STRETCHES FROM CNTRL AR...SEWD ACROSS CNTRL MS/AL AND SWD ALONG THE FL PENINSULA. STRONGEST CONVECTION WILL BE NOTED WITHIN AXIS OF GREATEST MOISTURE CHARACTERIZED BY PWAT VALUES APPROACHING 2 INCHES. ..DARROW.. 06/23/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT TUE JUN 23 2009/
